question: What will the Federal Reserve decide for the federal funds target range on 9 December 2026?
resolutionSource: Federal Reserve FOMC statement at federalreserve.gov on 9 December 2026.

outcomes.label: Hike 25 bp
outcomes.criteria: The upper bound rises by exactly 0.25 percentage points.

outcomes.label: Hike 50 bp+
outcomes.criteria: The upper bound rises by 0.50 percentage points or more.

outcomes.label: Cut
outcomes.criteria: The upper bound is lowered by any amount.
